description: Hub access results that may differ from baseline.json (recorded from the Hub at commit 3d56003, before navigation and page decisions moved to permissions). Each entry under "changes" is keyed "<path> @ <caller>" and holds the new expected "result", the "decision" that approved it and a short "note". Anything not listed here must match the baseline exactly.

/activity @ admin.decision: Booking management (Phase 3, on the Phase 2 API): accounts.view_all_bookings and accounts.assign_booking_tutor, which only the ADMIN role may hold (a superuser holds both under D1); /bookings opens for view_all_bookings. Lead management (backend accounts.0018, bookings.lead_views): the Leads page (/leads, /leads/<id>) opens for holders of accounts.view_all_leads -- the ADMIN role's alone, held by superusers too (D1) -- listing every lead with its source, status and owner BDE; accounts.add_lead offers Add lead and accounts.assign_lead_owner Assign / Reassign. Every other caller is sent where any page they cannot open sends them, and no leads endpoint is called. The sidebar offers it, second, to whoever may open it.
/activity @ admin.note: The sidebar also offers Booking slots (the administrator holds accounts.manage_booking_slots); nothing else changes. The sidebar also offers Bookings, in a Demo & Diagnostic section with Booking slots (the caller holds accounts.view_all_bookings); nothing else changes. The sidebar gains Leads; nothing else on the page changes.

/activity @ bde.decision: BDE portal phase 1 (dashboard and My Enquiries): accounts.view_own_enquiries and accounts.add_enquiry, which only the BDE role may hold (a superuser holds them under D1). My Leads (lead management): the BDE workspace's own leads are named leads in the Hub -- the sidebar's My Leads, Add lead -- with routes and APIs unchanged (/enquiries, /api/bde/enquiries/). My Leads shares the BDE's own booking links (the dashboard's ShareLinkButtons, GET /api/bde/booking-links/), and a lead's page sends them to that lead's parent on WhatsApp from the links' menus. BDE Hub redesign Phase 2 (shell and design system, approved 2026-11-07): the BDE workspace's sidebar becomes Dashboard, My Enquiries, Demo Bookings, Diagnostic Bookings and Follow-ups, then My Sales and Plans & Pricing (each badged Coming Soon) and Activity (lib/navigation BDE_WORKSPACE); My Leads is renamed My Enquiries, its routes and APIs unchanged (/enquiries, /api/bde/enquiries/). The new pages (/demo-bookings, /diagnostic-bookings, /follow-ups, /sales, /plans) open for the BDE role only (BDE_PAGES) on accounts.view_own_enquiries. /activity also opens on accounts.view_own_enquiries, which only a BDE or a superuser can hold, and App.jsx gives a BDE their own Activity page; every other caller's /activity is unchanged. Demo Bookings, Diagnostic Bookings, Follow-ups and Activity send the BDE to My Enquiries until their lists arrive (Phases 5 and 6); My Sales and Plans & Pricing are Coming Soon pages with no business logic. BDE Hub redesign Phase 6 (Follow-ups and Activity, approved 2026-11-07): /follow-ups lists the open parent-communication steps of the BDE's own leads' bookings from GET /api/bde/follow-ups/ -- by when they are due (overdue, today, upcoming, in Indian days) and step, each opening its booking's communication in the enquiry's workspace -- and opens, like its API, on accounts.view_own_lead_communications; /activity shows what has happened to those bookings from GET /api/bde/activity/, never who else acted or why. The BDE dashboard's agenda counts the follow-ups due today and overdue, and the enquiry workspace's Follow-ups and Activity tabs show that enquiry's.
/activity @ bde.note: The BDE now holds accounts.view_own_enquiries, so the Hub opens on its own dashboard (its first page) instead of its booking links; the sidebar offers Dashboard, My Enquiries and Booking links, and every path the BDE may not open sends it to the dashboard. With the dashboard's quick link sharing the sidebar no longer offers Booking links: the BDE dashboard's action row carries Demo Link and Diagnostic Link buttons beside My Enquiries and Add enquiry (each copies its link, with Copy Link, Share on WhatsApp and Preview Link in its menu, from GET /api/bde/booking-links/), and /booking-links lands on the dashboard. Their home page, the BDE dashboard: its Add enquiry button now reads Add lead. The BDE now opens /activity: their own Activity page, which for now sends them to My Enquiries, instead of being sent to the dashboard. Activity shows what has happened to the BDE's bookings (here the one booking made), each opening its booking.

Parent communication (Phase 3.1, read-only): accounts.view_all_communications (the ADMIN role group; a superuser under D1) shows a booking's communication in its sheet (GET /api/communications/bookings/<type>/<id>/); accounts.view_own_lead_communications (the BDE role group) shows the parent's answer beside each booking of the BDE's own enquiry and opens that booking's communication in a side sheet, own leads only. My Leads (lead management): the BDE workspace's own leads are named leads in the Hub -- the sidebar's My Leads, Add lead -- with routes and APIs unchanged (/enquiries, /api/bde/enquiries/). My Leads shares the BDE's own booking links (the dashboard's ShareLinkButtons, GET /api/bde/booking-links/), and a lead's page sends them to that lead's parent on WhatsApp from the links' menus. BDE Hub redesign Phase 2 (shell and design system, approved 2026-11-07): the BDE workspace's sidebar becomes Dashboard, My Enquiries, Demo Bookings, Diagnostic Bookings and Follow-ups, then My Sales and Plans & Pricing (each badged Coming Soon) and Activity (lib/navigation BDE_WORKSPACE); My Leads is renamed My Enquiries, its routes and APIs unchanged (/enquiries, /api/bde/enquiries/). The new pages (/demo-bookings, /diagnostic-bookings, /follow-ups, /sales, /plans) open for the BDE role only (BDE_PAGES) on accounts.view_own_enquiries. /activity also opens on accounts.view_own_enquiries, which only a BDE or a superuser can hold, and App.jsx gives a BDE their own Activity page; every other caller's /activity is unchanged. Demo Bookings, Diagnostic Bookings, Follow-ups and Activity send the BDE to My Enquiries until their lists arrive (Phases 5 and 6); My Sales and Plans & Pricing are Coming Soon pages with no business logic. BDE Hub redesign Phase 4 (unified enquiry workspace, approved 2026-11-07): one BDE enquiry opens as a workspace with tabs -- Overview (parent, student, enquiry and its journey), Bookings (every booking and what the BDE may do with it, unchanged), Tutor Feedback (the reports, for holders of accounts.view_own_lead_reports, read only when the tab opens), and Follow-ups, Sales & Payment and Activity, still to come -- kept in the URL (tab, highlight; booking and booking_type still open a booking's communication). The BDE dashboard's agenda and upcoming bookings open the workspace on Bookings with that booking highlighted (?tab=bookings&highlight=<booking>).
/enquiries/{enquiry_a} @ bde.note: One of the BDE's own enquiries with its bookings and call / WhatsApp links (GET /api/bde/enquiries/<id>/). With the dashboard's quick link sharing the sidebar no longer offers Booking links: the BDE dashboard's action row carries Demo Link and Diagnostic Link buttons beside My Enquiries and Add enquiry (each copies its link, with Copy Link, Share on WhatsApp and Preview Link in its menu, from GET /api/bde/booking-links/), and /booking-links lands on the dashboard. Since BDE cancellation (Phase 5.2 P3, Q22 answered 2026-10-31) the owner BDE may cancel a booking of their own enquiry that is still booked: a Cancel button per booking, offered when the API's actions say so; the API checks the lead is theirs on every request. Since P9 the page also has a Reports section (GET /api/bde/enquiries/<id>/reports/, answered for the lead's owner BDE only): each submitted report at its current version, with View report (an in-Hub dialog, read from the list), Download PDF (GET /api/bde/bookings/<type>/<id>/report/pdf/, fetched on click) and Send via WhatsApp (wa.me with the parent's registered number and the approved message; the BDE attaches the PDF by hand). Share PDF shows only where the browser can share files, which jsdom cannot. Nothing records a send. With Phase 1 the Bookings table has a Tutor column: the tutor's name and the booking's Google Meet link (opens in a new tab), "Meet link not configured" when the tutor has none, "Not assigned yet" before a tutor is assigned. Read-only: no control changes either, and no new request is made. With accounts.view_own_lead_communications the bookings table shows the parent's answer (Confirmation) and offers Communication, which opens that booking's communication read-only in a side sheet (GET /api/communications/bookings/<type>/<id>/, own leads only); nothing else changes. The lead's page: its Demo and Diagnostic links, sent to this parent on WhatsApp. The sidebar offers the redesigned BDE workspace: Dashboard, My Enquiries, Demo Bookings, Diagnostic Bookings, Follow-ups, My Sales, Plans & Pricing and Activity; nothing else on the page changes. The enquiry opens on its Overview tab: the six tabs are offered, the next booking opens Bookings, and the bookings table, the communication and the reports (requested only on Tutor Feedback) are on their own tabs.

/students/{stu_a}?tab=homework @ bde.decision: BDE portal phase 1 (dashboard and My Enquiries): accounts.view_own_enquiries and accounts.add_enquiry, which only the BDE role may hold (a superuser holds them under D1). My Leads (lead management): the BDE workspace's own leads are named leads in the Hub -- the sidebar's My Leads, Add lead -- with routes and APIs unchanged (/enquiries, /api/bde/enquiries/). My Leads shares the BDE's own booking links (the dashboard's ShareLinkButtons, GET /api/bde/booking-links/), and a lead's page sends them to that lead's parent on WhatsApp from the links' menus. BDE Hub redesign Phase 2 (shell and design system, approved 2026-11-07): the BDE workspace's sidebar becomes Dashboard, My Enquiries, Demo Bookings, Diagnostic Bookings and Follow-ups, then My Sales and Plans & Pricing (each badged Coming Soon) and Activity (lib/navigation BDE_WORKSPACE); My Leads is renamed My Enquiries, its routes and APIs unchanged (/enquiries, /api/bde/enquiries/). The new pages (/demo-bookings, /diagnostic-bookings, /follow-ups, /sales, /plans) open for the BDE role only (BDE_PAGES) on accounts.view_own_enquiries. /activity also opens on accounts.view_own_enquiries, which only a BDE or a superuser can hold, and App.jsx gives a BDE their own Activity page; every other caller's /activity is unchanged. Demo Bookings, Diagnostic Bookings, Follow-ups and Activity send the BDE to My Enquiries until their lists arrive (Phases 5 and 6); My Sales and Plans & Pricing are Coming Soon pages with no business logic. BDE Hub redesign Phase 3 (dashboard and My Enquiries, approved 2026-11-07): BDE-facing wording says enquiries, never leads -- the BDE dashboard's and My Enquiries' Add lead button reads Add Enquiry, while the administrators' Leads page keeps Add lead. My Enquiries is rebuilt on the shared page kit (components/page), its search, status and source filters, URL parameters and paging unchanged, with numbered page buttons beside Previous and Next, and a card per enquiry on a phone. The BDE dashboard gains Today's Agenda from GET /api/bde/dashboard/ (agenda: the BDE's own bookings on today's Indian date that hold their seat). BDE Hub redesign Phase 4 (unified enquiry workspace, approved 2026-11-07): one BDE enquiry opens as a workspace with tabs -- Overview (parent, student, enquiry and its journey), Bookings (every booking and what the BDE may do with it, unchanged), Tutor Feedback (the reports, for holders of accounts.view_own_lead_reports, read only when the tab opens), and Follow-ups, Sales & Payment and Activity, still to come -- kept in the URL (tab, highlight; booking and booking_type still open a booking's communication). The BDE dashboard's agenda and upcoming bookings open the workspace on Bookings with that booking highlighted (?tab=bookings&highlight=<booking>). BDE Hub redesign Phase 5 (Demo and Diagnostic Bookings, approved 2026-11-07): /demo-bookings and /diagnostic-bookings list the BDE's own leads' bookings of each type from GET /api/bde/bookings/<type>/ -- searched, filtered by status, by upcoming or past and by date range, and paged, all in the URL -- each opening its enquiry's workspace on Bookings with that booking highlighted, the way back returning to the list. The BDE dashboard's Demo and Diagnostic tiles open those lists. BDE Hub redesign Phase 6 (Follow-ups and Activity, approved 2026-11-07): /follow-ups lists the open parent-communication steps of the BDE's own leads' bookings from GET /api/bde/follow-ups/ -- by when they are due (overdue, today, upcoming, in Indian days) and step, each opening its booking's communication in the enquiry's workspace -- and opens, like its API, on accounts.view_own_lead_communications; /activity shows what has happened to those bookings from GET /api/bde/activity/, never who else acted or why. The BDE dashboard's agenda counts the follow-ups due today and overdue, and the enquiry workspace's Follow-ups and Activity tabs show that enquiry's.

With the dashboard's quick link sharing the sidebar no longer offers Booking links: the BDE dashboard's action row carries Demo Link and Diagnostic Link buttons beside My Enquiries and Add enquiry (each copies its link, with Copy Link, Share on WhatsApp and Preview Link in its menu, from GET /api/bde/booking-links/), and /booking-links lands on the dashboard. Their home page, the BDE dashboard: its Add enquiry button now reads Add lead. The sidebar offers the redesigned BDE workspace: Dashboard, My Enquiries, Demo Bookings, Diagnostic Bookings, Follow-ups, My Sales, Plans & Pricing and Activity; nothing else on the page changes. The BDE is on its dashboard, whose Add lead button now reads Add Enquiry; nothing else it is offered changes. The BDE dashboard's booking rows now open the enquiry's workspace on Bookings, that booking highlighted. The BDE dashboard's Demo and Diagnostic tiles now open Demo Bookings and Diagnostic Bookings. The BDE dashboard's agenda now counts the follow-ups due today, opening Follow-ups on them.

BDE Hub redesign Phase 6 (Follow-ups and Activity, approved 2026-11-07): /follow-ups lists the open parent-communication steps of the BDE's own leads' bookings from GET /api/bde/follow-ups/ -- by when they are due (overdue, today, upcoming, in Indian days) and step, each opening its booking's communication in the enquiry's workspace -- and opens, like its API, on accounts.view_own_lead_communications; /activity shows what has happened to those bookings from GET /api/bde/activity/, never who else acted or why. /my-bookings/demo/{my_booking_a}/report.decision: Tutor report page (Phase 5.2 P8, design D.2): /my-bookings/<demo|diagnostic>/<id>/report is part of My Bookings and opens exactly as /my-bookings does -- for the TUTOR role holding accounts.view_assigned_bookings; every other caller is sent where /my-bookings sends them. The page reads only the tutor booking and report APIs, which serve a booking to its assigned tutor alone (anyone else is answered as if it did not exist). My Leads (lead management): the BDE workspace's own leads are named leads in the Hub -- the sidebar's My Leads, Add lead -- with routes and APIs unchanged (/enquiries, /api/bde/enquiries/). My Leads shares the BDE's own booking links (the dashboard's ShareLinkButtons, GET /api/bde/booking-links/), and a lead's page sends them to that lead's parent on WhatsApp from the links' menus. BDE Hub redesign Phase 2 (shell and design system, approved 2026-11-07): the BDE workspace's sidebar becomes Dashboard, My Enquiries, Demo Bookings, Diagnostic Bookings and Follow-ups, then My Sales and Plans & Pricing (each badged Coming Soon) and Activity (lib/navigation BDE_WORKSPACE); My Leads is renamed My Enquiries, its routes and APIs unchanged (/enquiries, /api/bde/enquiries/). The new pages (/demo-bookings, /diagnostic-bookings, /follow-ups, /sales, /plans) open for the BDE role only (BDE_PAGES) on accounts.view_own_enquiries. /activity also opens on accounts.view_own_enquiries, which only a BDE or a superuser can hold, and App.jsx gives a BDE their own Activity page; every other caller's /activity is unchanged. Demo Bookings, Diagnostic Bookings, Follow-ups and Activity send the BDE to My Enquiries until their lists arrive (Phases 5 and 6); My Sales and Plans & Pricing are Coming Soon pages with no business logic. BDE Hub redesign Phase 3 (dashboard and My Enquiries, approved 2026-11-07): BDE-facing wording says enquiries, never leads -- the BDE dashboard's and My Enquiries' Add lead button reads Add Enquiry, while the administrators' Leads page keeps Add lead. My Enquiries is rebuilt on the shared page kit (components/page), its search, status and source filters, URL parameters and paging unchanged, with numbered page buttons beside Previous and Next, and a card per enquiry on a phone. The BDE dashboard gains Today's Agenda from GET /api/bde/dashboard/ (agenda: the BDE's own bookings on today's Indian date that hold their seat). BDE Hub redesign Phase 4 (unified enquiry workspace, approved 2026-11-07): one BDE enquiry opens as a workspace with tabs -- Overview (parent, student, enquiry and its journey), Bookings (every booking and what the BDE may do with it, unchanged), Tutor Feedback (the reports, for holders of accounts.view_own_lead_reports, read only when the tab opens), and Follow-ups, Sales & Payment and Activity, still to come -- kept in the URL (tab, highlight; booking and booking_type still open a booking's communication). The BDE dashboard's agenda and upcoming bookings open the workspace on Bookings with that booking highlighted (?tab=bookings&highlight=<booking>). BDE Hub redesign Phase 5 (Demo and Diagnostic Bookings, approved 2026-11-07): /demo-bookings and /diagnostic-bookings list the BDE's own leads' bookings of each type from GET /api/bde/bookings/<type>/ -- searched, filtered by status, by upcoming or past and by date range, and paged, all in the URL -- each opening its enquiry's workspace on Bookings with that booking highlighted, the way back returning to the list. The BDE dashboard's Demo and Diagnostic tiles open those lists. BDE Hub redesign Phase 6 (Follow-ups and Activity, approved 2026-11-07): /follow-ups lists the open parent-communication steps of the BDE's own leads' bookings from GET /api/bde/follow-ups/ -- by when they are due (overdue, today, upcoming, in Indian days) and step, each opening its booking's communication in the enquiry's workspace -- and opens, like its API, on accounts.view_own_lead_communications; /activity shows what has happened to those bookings from GET /api/bde/activity/, never who else acted or why. The BDE dashboard's agenda counts the follow-ups due today and overdue, and the enquiry workspace's Follow-ups and Activity tabs show that enquiry's.

The BDE is on its dashboard, whose Add lead button now reads Add Enquiry; nothing else it is offered changes.
